hypothesis: A realistic software-demonstration visual style with selective signaling will improve viewer choice-to-watch and completion behavior versus the earlier abstract motion-graphics style.

treatment.style: realistic spreadsheet and Power Query screen demonstration

minimum_evidence.note: Do not declare a visual-style winner below this sample. V2 currently has only 21 total views and no retention report yet.

qualitative_checks: first meaningful proof shown in first second
main teaching visual never obscured by captions
every overlay has an instructional purpose
decision_rule: After the minimum sample is reached, prefer the style that improves stayed-to-watch and average percentage viewed without reducing clarity or violating authenticity/monetization standards.
